quotes.text: Wow, just wow! An unforgettable experience. A super friendly welcome and excellent planning. Security checks, briefings, and emergency procedures, all carried out quite quickly. A 15-minute flight that will never be forgotten. A scenic flight over Manhattan....amazing. Thank you to the entire team for letting us experience this.

Amazing experience. I think everyone who visits NYC should try this at least once. It’s the right way to see the city and an unforgettable experience. The process is simple and swift without any issues. Staff and pilots are extremely helpful and professional.

A wonderful experience with Charm Aviation. Everything was perfect: the welcome, the schedule, the service, and the flight! A big thank you to pilot Salvator for his kindness and professionalism! 🚁 I recommend it and see you soon.

Wow!! It's a feast for the eyes! A magical experience. A dedicated team, a must-do. The team is very accommodating; I was able to change my schedule without any difficulty. Flying over New York is fabulous.
We took a private flight and it was the BEST service and experience! Nick and the crew were always on point with all the process — my clients were beyond happy!
